observed_value: PP03 flagged two rows as source period earlier than report_date
anchor_value: Current-period SOI table 6 contains the same TCW ND Parent Holdings Class A Units and AGY Equity LLC Class D Preferred Units rows at June 30, 2023
rationale: Raw source shows the flagged identifiers are not solely comparative-period facts. In the June 30, 2023 SOI, table 6 row 12 lists TCW ND Parent Holdings LLC Class A Units with 0.0% of net assets and no fair value, and table 6 row 18 lists AGY Equity LLC Class D Preferred Units with 0.0% of net assets and no fair value. Although the same names also appear in prior-period or rollforward tables, the current-period SOI independently supports retaining these current zero-value positions; therefore the PP03 comparative-period flag is a false alarm.
